node.title: Devel::Peek Dump() not printing out
node.author: ultranerds
node.doctext:
Hi, I'm try to write a script that accesses a "curl" command to grab a paypal transaction back. The "grab" works ok, but I'm having fun with the utf8 characters. I'm trying to do some debugging using Devel::Peek, but it doesn't want to work. I literally get no output. I know the command is running, as I'm putting debug text either side of the code, and they print fine. Surely this is right? use Devel::Peek; Dump("foo"); I've even tried: use Devel::Peek; Devel::Peek::Dump("foo"); and use Devel::Peek; print Dump("foo");

What am I doing wrong? I'm baffled

Thanks

Andy
